title: Data-driven prediction of battery cycle life before capacity degradation
notes: Anchor for curve-based features. Variance of dQ(V) between early cycles; 9.1% test error from first 100 cycles. Train/primary-test/secondary-test split is by cell but assigned at random, not by protocol.

title: Comprehensive Machine Learning for Lithium-Ion Battery State-of-Health Estimation Using Group-Wise Cross-Validation
notes: CLOSEST PRIOR WORK - see 2.3. Compares random split vs cell-wise GroupKFold across seven models. Random reaches R2=0.9999; group-wise ~0.91. Frames the difference as optimistic bias. Does NOT go to protocol level; no ceiling; no target derivation analysis.

title: Charging Phase Health Indicators for Battery State-of-Health Estimation: A Systematic Comparison of CC, CV, and Combined Approaches under Cross-Battery Validation
notes: Reports a 119% performance gap between 5-fold CV and LOBO on NASA. Independent corroboration of 5.1's first step. VERIFY IN FULL before citing the 119% figure - taken from the abstract.
